cited.basis: Same reading, Isaiah 4, now third of four: benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41581-41585.

The same chapter, shortened at the front. The pre-1955 books print Is. 4, 1-6
beginning `Apprehendent septem mulieres` (missale-romanum-later-composite-pre-1955-body 39468-39472); the
witness prints `I s . 4, 2-6` beginning `Tn die illa erit germen D6mini in
magnific6ntia` (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 41583-41585). Verse 1 is gone. This
is the one departure in the file where a unit both moves and changes, and it is
recorded as two rows because they are two different claims.
